title: Wire governed persona instruction sets for 11 council seats (live-reasoning enrichment)
objective: Enrich the Working Conclave (M4) so live seats reason like their office, not as an undifferentiated structured-output sink. Author 11 versioned persona instruction sets (6 standing roles + 5 case captains), a registry + deterministic renderer composed from the immutable AgentContext and RoleContract (forbidden actions, allowed capabilities, frozen snapshot refs, governance preamble that never authorizes), and bind the per-seat system prompt into the live seat-model factory. The deterministic path stays persona-free so CI remains hermetic. Every persona participates in the seat run identity (prompt_version + digest already digested by seat_runtime._canonical).
forbidden_actions: commit directly to a protected baseline
change a formal Foundry Program stage
authorize scientific, clinical, spending, outreach, transaction, or production action
commit a real API key or identity signing secret to the repository

acceptance_criteria.description: All 6 standing roles and all 5 case captains have a resolvable, versioned persona; unknown roles fail closed.
Persona rendering embeds the role's office brief, forbidden actions, allowed capabilities, and frozen snapshot refs; persona never authorizes approval/commit/gate.
Live seat-model factory binds the per-seat persona system prompt; deterministic path remains persona-free (hermetic CI).
Contracts, secret scan, history-secret scan, schema drift, wheel, full test suite clean (incl. Postgres-backed tests with env sourced).
